scientific_question: Under one matched local WorldMemArena protocol, what complete three-seed estimates do eight recent multimodal or agent-memory implementations achieve without importing official result numbers or silently falling back across modality or endpoint boundaries?
estimand: For each method and every frozen metric or slice, the mean and seed-level variability over seeds 0, 1, and 2 on the same 150 sample clusters and 7906 QA records per seed.
decision_informed: Whether each method is eligible to populate the fixed local baseline table and serve as a comparator for a later, independently frozen AgentEnhance experiment.

evidence_roles.full_small_split: same-protocol comparator evidence after a separate post-lifecycle authorization
evidence_roles.AgentEnhance_results: unobserved and prohibited during baseline execution

methods.runtime_guard: local endpoint and explicit model forwarding before agent construction

service_topology.reason: Retains the frozen four-GPU allocated service-window accounting and sequential sample policy used by Wave1 while swapping only the primary retrieval encoder required by each method.

failure_semantics.unit: Any nonzero process exit, missing denominator, identity mismatch, guard absence, service-log HTTP 4xx/5xx, OOM, traceback, A-Mem extraction error, or Omni-SimpleMem add failure seals the fresh unit as TERMINAL_REJECTED.
failure_semantics.scheduler: A seed is eligible only with exactly 150 accepted and zero rejected units and no infrastructure failure.
failure_semantics.retry: No in-place retry or resume. A diagnosed technical recovery requires a fresh root and successor authorization while retaining the failed root.
failure_semantics.silent_fallback: A GME HTTP 400 followed by source-level text fallback is still a technical rejection because the per-unit service-log delta retains the 400.

transition_rule.current: Implementation may be packaged and validated without GPU use.
transition_rule.next: After Wave1 terminal acceptance and release, materialize and audit the two exact project-owned models, then execute only the guarded lifecycle successor.
transition_rule.numerical_unlock: Only after a method lifecycle is terminal-accepted may a new FROZEN_BEFORE_EXECUTION numerical authorization bind these exact implementation hashes and fresh roots.
transition_rule.claim_unlock: Only complete, independently audited three-seed summaries may populate numeric cells; operational success alone is not a superiority or SOTA claim.

prohibited_actions: starting any Wave2 service or model download while Wave1 is active
executing the full scheduler with this implementation prefreeze in place of a post-lifecycle numerical authorization
editing the frozen WorldMemArena source checkout
using official paper numbers in same-protocol local comparison cells
selecting methods, metrics, slices, seeds, or failed units after observing numerical outcomes
deleting any model before all dependent lifecycle, numerical, projection, archive, and cleanup gates accept
